segments.name: Direct sales
segments.description: Sells nutrigenomic dietary supplements, skin and hair care, gut health and nootropic products directly to customers through an international network of independent consultants.
segments.evidence: The Company operates in a single operating segment by selling products directly to customers through an international network of independent consultants that operate in an integrated manner.

revenueModel.text: Customers and independent consultants pay the company for its nutrigenomic and wellness products, sold through a commission-based direct sales network.
revenueModel.evidence: We provide quality, scientifically validated products to customers and independent consultants as well as a financially rewarding commission-based direct sales opportunity to our independent consultants.

changes.text: In 2025, the company acquired the critical operating assets of LoveBiome, adding a LoveBiome product line.
changes.evidence: On October 1, 2025, the Company closed on the purchase of critical assets of Global Organics Merchants, LLC, dba LoveBiome ("LoveBiome") pursuant to an asset purchase agreement between the parties.

changes.text: In 2026, the company ceased operations in Hong Kong and Singapore and closed those markets.
changes.evidence: On May 31, 2026, we ceased operations in Hong Kong and Singapore and closed those markets.
